record.shotList: Summary: MLSs, INT, Bradley's office. Bradley pins the Oak Leaf Cluster to the Distinguished Service Medal on Maj Gen Joseph S Bradley. Unidentified officer reads citation and women observe. LS, MS, Omar Bradley pins citation on Joseph Bradley, wearing dark glasses; they shake hands. MS, Joseph Bradley speaks. LS, MSs, officers file by shaking hands with the two women and Joseph Bradley. INSERTS OF MEDALS OF HONOR.: 06/20/1951: (slated 06/13) MCU, medals laid out in star shape with one in center. Eleven medals in star, one in center. CU, hands holding box inscribed "Medal of Honor". The box is opened, showing the medal, service ribbon and rosette. The box is closed. MEDALS OF HONOR, ROSE GARDEN.: White House, Washington, DC: 07/05/1951: Pres Harry S Truman presenting Medals of Honor to Capt Raymond Harvey, Capt Lewis L Millett, M/Sgt Stanley T Adams, and Sgt Einer H Ingman. Cut-ins, relatives and officials. Gens Omar N Bradley and George C Marshall with the men. They are congratulated by both. Gen J Lawton Collins speaking to one of the awardees, to relatives. CU, M/Sgt Stanley T Adams. The Sgt holding a little boy. CU, Sgt Einer H Ingman. A Capt, one of the awardees, congratulated by relatives. The two Capts posing with an unidentified woman. GORDON GRAY.: 07/18/1951: Pres Harry Truman looks on as Frank K Anderson swears in Gray as director of Psychological Strategy Board, then congratulates him. ARRIVAL OF GEN ALPHONSE JUIN.: National Airport, Washington, DC: 01/08/1952: Gen Juin arrives by plane. Scenes on the airfield as the Gen moves around group of officers. The Gen shakes hands with Gen Omar N Bradley; Amb Henri Bonnet is standing between them.
record.title: GENERAL OMAR N. BRADLEY PRESENTS OAK LEAF CLUSTER TO MAJ. GEN. JOSEPH S. BRADLEY
